name: Kim Yo-han
bio: Kim Yo-han (born July 23, 1994) is a South Korean actor, known for A Killer Paradox (2024) and Officer Black Belt (2024).

credits.title: New Recruit: Haunted Military Hospital
credits.overview: Seeking a sweet escape, a group of rookie soldiers is admitted to what they believe is a paradise-like military hospital, only to uncover its dark secrets as they confront a series of terrifying rumors.

credits.title: The Intern
credits.overview: Ki-ho, a retiree with 37 years of experience, joins fashion start-up WOO22 a senior intern, he struggles with its digital, unconventional culture. Despite their differences, Ki-ho and Sun-woo, the start-up's young CEO, learn from each other and form an unexpected bond.

credits.title: Husbands in Action
credits.overview: A detective teams up with his ex-wife's new husband to chase down her kidnappers. Can this unlikely duo put aside their differences for one wild rescue?

credits.title: You Are the Apple of My Eye
credits.overview: A group of close friends who attend a private school all have a debilitating crush on the sunny star pupil, Sun-ah. The only member of the group who claims not to is Jin-woo, but he ends up loving her as well.

credits.title: Officer Black Belt
credits.overview: A talented martial artist who can't walk past a person in need unites with a probation officer to fight and prevent crime as a martial arts officer.

credits.title: My Heart Puppy
credits.overview: Min-soo is about to get married when his fiancée suddenly admits that she is allergic to dogs. Now the guy's best friend, the golden retriever Rooney, needs a new family. With the help of his cousin and social media, Min-soo starts looking for a new home for Rooney.

credits.title: Move to Mind
credits.overview: Bo-young, who suffers from a rare disease that becomes dangerous if she is too emotional, meets Cheol-gi, a rural young man, and falls in love.
